title: Two calculation groups: the one with the higher precedence wraps the other, so ( 10 + 2 ) * 2 = 24

source.supports: the page's precedence example is this model: a measure equal to 10, a group of precedence 100 with SELECTEDMEASURE() + 2 and a group of precedence 200 with SELECTEDMEASURE() * 2, both applied; it gives 24 and says the output won't be 14

source.quote: the calculation group with the higher precedence is applied first
source.supports: Scale (200) is applied first, so its SELECTEDMEASURE () is then replaced by Adjust's expression
